title: Course-Level Graduate Futures Insight and Action Packs

decisionLog.title: Front-load Power BI and Fabric engineering in Year 1
decisionLog.summary: Use a two-stage student-engineering model in 2026/27: the already-funded £4,000 six-week summer internship creates the first working prototype, followed by part-time Power BI / Microsoft Fabric engineering through December to harden the reusable data model, measures, report build, refresh process and handover. The continuation is funded from 2.1.1's existing 0.25 FTE share of the £21,000 King's Edge Analytics & Data Capability Year 1 envelope and does not increase the Core Year 1 total.
